_note: Collective Edge is MOSTLY monochrome, not strictly. A black CE block (the Collective) against a skewed Edge wedge, on a grey ramp that carries documents, decks, UI chrome and body copy; that restraint is the brand. Two things are deliberately not grey. The Edge wedge may be rendered in CE gold #FFD630, which is preferred wherever the mark has to read small (favicons, tabs, avatars) and on co-brand surfaces. And on a partner co-brand surface the partner accent is expected to appear. White is the primary surface for documents; black is reserved for hero / section-divider / title surfaces.

black.role: Primary brand black; hero / divider surfaces

fog.role: The Edge wedge in its restrained grey treatment; the quiet half of the pair with gold

gold.role: The Edge wedge in its color treatment. The one hue CE owns, used on the wedge only, never on the block, the letters or as a UI accent

white.role: Primary brand white; primary document canvas

status._note: Used sparingly — healthcare context. Not decorative accents.

partners._note: 'Powered by CE' co-brand accents. Used inside that partner's own co-brand surface. They color the partner's side of the lockup, never the CE block or letters; CE's own hue is brandCore.gold on the wedge.
